summary: This joint resolution nullifies the Bureau of Land Management's December 2024 Coastal Plain Oil and Gas Leasing Program Record of Decision by declaring it disapproved under the Congressional Review Act so it has no legal effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill nullifies a rule that made 1.2 million acres unavailable for oil and gas leasing in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to protect resources. By nullifying this rule, the bill effectively allows for more oil and gas development, which generally leads to less environmental protection.
